title: 2023 Winter Umpire Training Program
description: Umpire training courses are being confirmed all across the state as NSWCUSA’s winter training program with 10 Laws of Cricket courses scheduled across regional New South Wales and metropolitan Sydney.

title: Simon Moore recognised by NSWCUSA
description: Simon joined NSWCUSA in 1992 and was upgraded to Full Membership in 1993. A stalwart of the Hornsby Ku-ring-gai and Hills District Cricket Umpires’ Association, Simon is truly deserving of Principal membership of the Association.
